media.description: 'The Century Report Newsroom' card: a Claude agent designed a 240-251 GHz sub-terahertz transmitter chain in simulation in under a week; humans supplied transistor layouts and final assembly. Source: arXiv.
media.ocr_text: Claude agent designs a sub-terahertz transmitter in simulation. KEY FACT: Full transmitter chain designed in under a week. What happened: Researchers had Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.8 drive industry chip-design software to design a 240 to 251 GHz transmitter for radar and gas sensing. Results are from simulation; humans supplied transistor layouts and final assembly. What it means: The authors say design time and labor could fall from months to a few days, which suggests smaller teams could take on chips that demand rare expertise. Fully autonomous design remains their forecast. Sources: arXiv
